quote.default: We shipped our launch video in a single afternoon
quote.hint: the testimonial line, word for word

name.hint: who said it; also gives the avatar initials

role.hint: their role; empty hides the line

company.hint: company mark at the byline end; empty hides it

emphasis.hint: words from the quote to underline; empty or no match draws nothing

dy.hint: moves the card up (negative) or down, in pixels; set automatically to keep it off your face
